comment: EcoLens Places spine — every entry is a geography EcoLens has reported on or is actively developing. The map, stories, insights and community tabs are three lenses on these places. Statuses: published | coming_soon | in_development.

places.name: Vancouver's Buried Streams
places.dek: A hundred years ago there were more than fifty salmon streams running through Vancouver. Most were buried. A handful are now coming back.
facts: 120 km of salmon streams buried under the City of Vancouver
Chum salmon returned to Still Creek in 2012 after ~80 years

places.name: Pakistan 2022 Floods
places.dek: One third of a country underwater. A research-led reconstruction of the 2022 floods from satellite evidence, and what has and hasn't recovered since.
facts: Reconstructed from UNOSAT + NASA Landsat evidence
19 chapters, updated as recovery data lands

places.name: BC's Drying Watersheds
places.dek: Three years of shrinking snowpacks, decades of clearcut logging, and a water-pricing system stuck in the 20th century. How BC's watersheds came apart in 2026.
facts: Provincial snowpack at 48% of normal by June 2026
Snow Basin Index hit 0% on Vancouver Island + South Coast

places.name: Buried Streams of New Westminster
places.kicker: IN DEVELOPMENT · WITH HOMEGROWN PIGEON SOCIETY
places.dek: Tracing the surface streams that ran through what is now New Westminster, what got piped underground, and the daylighting work that could bring some back. EcoLens's first community partnership.
